athens.title: Medical Cannabis in Athens
athens.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Athens: how the process works, where to redeem, and what to expect when you land in the capital.
athens.flight: Direct flights from most of Europe, daily
athens.lede: Athens is the most common way into Greece, and it has the densest network of licensed pharmacies in the country. Landing here puts you in the easiest position to redeem a prescription the same day.
why: The highest concentration of licensed pharmacies in Greece, spread across neighbourhoods
Frequent direct flights year-round, including evening arrivals
Most pharmacists in the centre speak good English
The departure point for nearly every domestic flight to the islands
athens.local: Athens is also a transit city: many visitors stop for a day or two on the way to an island. If that is your route, it is worth redeeming here rather than waiting — the choice is wider and you are far less likely to walk into a pharmacy that does not dispense medical cannabis.
athens.tip: If you continue to an island the same day, remember the product stays with you inside Greece — a domestic flight is not a border crossing. Still, carry the prescription and your passport on the internal leg.
athens.season: Athens is the least seasonal destination in Greece. The airport runs at full capacity all year and flights arrive daily even in January. What changes is the crowd: July and August are very hot and busy, and in August many local businesses close for their own annual holiday. In winter the city is quiet, pleasant for walking, and every service operates normally.
athens.timing: Because flights are so frequent, Athens is the easiest place to recover from a planning mistake. Even people who start late usually find a way. Still, there is no reason to rely on that. A questionnaire filled in three days before departure gives the physician comfortable room on any plan.
athens.q1: I only have one day in Athens before a connecting flight. Is that enough?
athens.a1: If the prescription is already in hand, yes — redeeming at a pharmacy takes minutes. If you have not started the process, one day is tight even on VIP and depends on working hours. Start before you fly.
athens.q2: Can I redeem at the airport?
athens.a2: Airport pharmacies do not necessarily dispense medical cannabis. Do not plan around it. Redeem in the city, where the choice is much wider.

thessaloniki.title: Medical Cannabis in Thessaloniki
thessaloniki.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Thessaloniki: how it works in Greece's second city, and what differs from Athens.
thessaloniki.lede: Thessaloniki is Greece's second city and a genuine regional centre — which means a full pharmacy network without the crowds of Athens.
why: A university city with well-developed medical infrastructure
Short distances — most of the centre is walkable
Noticeably less tourist pressure than Athens in season
A convenient base for Halkidiki and the north
thessaloniki.local: Many visitors use Thessaloniki as the gateway to Halkidiki. If you are continuing to the peninsula, redeem in the city before you leave: choice in the resort villages is far narrower, and outside peak season some pharmacies keep reduced hours.
thessaloniki.tip: The flight is short and that invites last-minute planning. Resist it: the Basic plan needs one to two weeks, and a spontaneous weekend booking will not fit inside it. Fast or VIP are the realistic answers there.
thessaloniki.season: Thessaloniki works all year as a real city, not a resort. Winters are cold and wet by Greek standards and summers are humid. Tourism concentrates in summer and around holidays, but the urban infrastructure — pharmacies included — does not depend on the season. That makes it one of the most reliable options for travel outside the peak months.
thessaloniki.timing: Distances inside the city are short, so redeeming is rarely a logistical problem. The constraint is almost always the physician's review window, not geography. Choose the plan that matches how far ahead you booked.
thessaloniki.q1: I'm continuing to Halkidiki. Redeem in Thessaloniki or there?
thessaloniki.a1: In Thessaloniki. Halkidiki is a dispersed resort region and pharmacy choice there is much narrower, especially off-season. The drive from the city takes one to two hours, and nobody wants to make it twice.
thessaloniki.q2: Is the process different from Athens?
thessaloniki.a2: No. The prescription is digital and valid at any licensed pharmacy in Greece. The only difference is how many pharmacies are available — Athens has more, but Thessaloniki has plenty.

crete.title: Medical Cannabis in Crete
crete.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Crete: what is different on Greece's largest island, and where it makes sense to redeem.
crete.lede: Crete is large enough that where you are on it genuinely matters. Heraklion to Chania is about two and a half hours by road — plan around the side you are staying on.
why: The only Greek island with two active international airports
Real cities with full infrastructure, not just resort villages
Pharmacies open year-round, including outside the season
Direct summer flights from much of Europe
crete.local: Most licensed pharmacies are concentrated in Heraklion, Chania and Rethymno. If you are staying at a resort in the south or east of the island, the distance to a dispensing pharmacy can be significant — worth checking before you set out, not after.
crete.tip: Crete is the destination where arranging the prescription before you land pays off most. Not because of availability, but because of distance: a round trip to a pharmacy from the south can cost you the better part of a day.
crete.season: Crete has the longest season of any Greek island. Temperatures stay pleasant from April through November, and in winter the island keeps functioning — mainly in the larger towns. Resort villages in the south and east shrink dramatically between November and March, but Heraklion, Chania and Rethymno operate all year.
crete.timing: Because the island is long and the roads are slow, timing matters more here than almost anywhere else in Greece. Arriving with the prescription already issued removes the single biggest logistical cost of the trip.
crete.q1: I'm staying in Elounda. Where is the nearest pharmacy?
crete.a1: Elounda is in the east, so you would likely go to Agios Nikolaos or Heraklion. We do not keep a live address list and will not invent one — on the VIP plan we help locate a dispensing pharmacy near your accommodation, based on a real-time check.
crete.q2: I land in Chania but I'm driving to Heraklion. Does it matter where I redeem?
crete.a2: No. The prescription is valid at any licensed pharmacy in Greece. Redeem wherever is convenient, at any point in your trip.

rhodes.title: Medical Cannabis in Rhodes
rhodes.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Rhodes: how it works on the island, and what to know about seasonality.
rhodes.lede: Rhodes Town functions as a full urban centre rather than a resort strip, which makes it one of the more straightforward islands to deal with.
why: A large old and new town, both compact and walkable
Urban infrastructure that operates year-round
Well connected to Kos and the rest of the Dodecanese
Wide accommodation range from town to coastal villages
rhodes.local: Pharmacies are concentrated in Rhodes Town. If you are staying in Faliraki, Lindos or the southern coastal villages, allow 20 to 60 minutes each way. Outside the season some village pharmacies close entirely.
rhodes.tip: Rhodes is sharply seasonal. Between November and March activity in the villages contracts and the town is the dependable address. Plan around the month you are travelling, not the average.
rhodes.season: From April to October the island runs at full capacity with frequent direct flights. Between November and March the picture changes completely: coastal villages empty out, many businesses close, and direct flights thin out. Rhodes Town itself continues to operate as an ordinary town throughout.
rhodes.timing: The short flight makes Rhodes a long-weekend destination. On that kind of schedule, a prescription that arrives on day three is a prescription you missed. Anyone travelling for three or four days should start before the trip, not during it.
rhodes.q1: I'm in Faliraki. Is it worth driving into Rhodes Town?
rhodes.a1: Faliraki is about 15 minutes from town, so it is not a problem. Villages further south — Lindos or Prasonisi — mean a much longer drive, and there it is worth planning the pharmacy visit for a day you are heading into town anyway.
rhodes.q2: I'm arriving in February. Is everything closed?
rhodes.a2: Not everything, but a lot. Rhodes Town operates year-round including pharmacies. In the coastal villages you will likely find very little open. Plan to redeem in town.

kos.title: Medical Cannabis in Kos
kos.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Kos: a small island, short distances, and what that means in practice.
kos.flight: Seasonal direct flights, otherwise via Athens
kos.lede: Kos is small and flat, and that is a genuine advantage: from anywhere on the island you can reach Kos Town in under an hour, usually much less.
why: A compact island — no distances that complicate anything
Kos Town concentrates most services
Very popular with families
Short ferry hops to Rhodes and neighbouring islands
kos.local: Almost all licensed pharmacies are in Kos Town. The villages — Kardamena, Tigaki, Kefalos — are small, and some have no pharmacy operating outside the season. The drive into town is short, so this is rarely a real obstacle.
kos.tip: Most flights to Kos are seasonal. Outside the summer months the usual route is via Athens — which conveniently gives you a chance to redeem there instead.
kos.season: Kos is a summer destination in the clearest sense. Direct flights run mainly between May and October, and outside that window the route goes through Athens. In winter the island is very quiet and a large share of tourist businesses are closed. Kos Town keeps functioning, but at a reduced pace and on shorter hours.
kos.timing: The island's size is the safety margin here: even if something is not arranged in advance, there is room to fix it. That said, at the height of summer traffic on the coast road is slower than you would expect.
kos.q1: We're a family staying in Kardamena. How does this work?
kos.a1: Kardamena is about 25 minutes from Kos Town. The questionnaire and the review happen remotely from your phone, so the only trip required is the redemption itself. Combine it with a day you are going into town anyway.
kos.q2: Can I take the ferry to Rhodes and redeem there?
kos.a2: You can — the prescription is valid throughout Greece and the islands are connected by ferry. But there is no reason to: whatever is available in Rhodes is available in Kos Town.

santorini.title: Medical Cannabis in Santorini
santorini.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Santorini: a small, expensive island, and why arranging everything in advance matters here.
santorini.lede: Santorini is a small island built around luxury tourism. The infrastructure exists, but it is limited — and this is exactly where landing with a prescription already in hand is worth a day of your holiday.
why: Fira and Oia concentrate the services
Short distances, but heavy traffic in season
A very popular honeymoon destination
Regular ferries to Crete and Mykonos
santorini.local: Pharmacies are concentrated in Fira, the island's capital. Oia and the other villages are far more limited. At peak season traffic on the main road is very slow, and a drive that should take 20 minutes can take an hour.
santorini.tip: The typical stay in Santorini is three or four nights. On that schedule, starting a medical process on the island is simply wasted effort — start before you fly.
santorini.season: Santorini has the sharpest seasonality of any Greek island. Between May and September it is packed, prices peak and traffic is heavy. In winter many hotels and restaurants in Oia close entirely and Fira is the only fully functioning centre. There are few direct international flights — the usual route is via Athens by domestic flight or ferry.
santorini.timing: With three or four nights and a physician review window measured in days, the arithmetic does not work unless you start early. This is the destination where advance planning stops being a convenience and becomes the requirement.
santorini.q1: We only have two days in Santorini. Is it realistic?
santorini.a1: Only if the prescription is already in hand. With two days on the island, any process that begins after you land will finish after you have left. Start a week before and land ready.
santorini.q2: We're staying in Oia. Do we need to go to Fira?
santorini.a2: Most likely yes. Fira concentrates most services on the island, pharmacies included. The drive is short at normal times, but around sunset — when everyone is heading to Oia — it can be very slow. Plan for the morning.

mykonos.title: Medical Cannabis in Mykonos
mykonos.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Mykonos: what is available on the island, and what matters about where you can use it.
mykonos.lede: Mykonos is an intense nightlife destination, and precisely because of that it is worth being exact about what is permitted: the prescription is valid, but it is not a licence to use anywhere.
why: Chora, the port town, concentrates the services
A small island — distances measured in minutes
An international crowd, English everywhere
Good connections to Santorini and Athens
mykonos.local: Pharmacies are in Chora. Outside town, in the beach villages and club areas, there is no real infrastructure. At peak season the island is extremely crowded and nothing should be left to the last moment.
mykonos.tip: A point worth emphasising here in particular: use is intended for private accommodation. Mykonos is a town of clubs and beaches, and the prescription does not cover use in public space — not on the beach, not in a club, not in the street.
mykonos.season: Mykonos runs at full intensity between May and October and quietens considerably in winter. There are few direct international flights and the route usually goes through Athens. In season the island is crowded, prices are high, and traffic between Chora and the beaches is slow. Off-season Chora keeps functioning but most nightlife closes.
mykonos.timing: Mykonos is a destination people visit briefly and at speed — the opposite of what running a medical process on location requires. A prescription arranged in advance is not a convenience here; it is the practical condition.
mykonos.q1: Can I use it at the beach or in a club?
mykonos.a1: No. This matters especially in Mykonos: the prescription permits possession and use in a medical context, in private accommodation. It does not cover public space — beach, club, bar or street. Enforcement in those places exists.
mykonos.q2: I'm going from Mykonos to Santorini. Does the prescription still apply?
mykonos.a2: Yes. The prescription is valid throughout Greece, and moving between islands is not a border crossing. Carry the prescription and your passport on the ferry as well.

corfu.title: Medical Cannabis in Corfu
corfu.desc: Medical cannabis prescriptions for visitors in Corfu: a green island in the Ionian, and how it differs from the Aegean islands.
corfu.lede: Corfu is unlike the Greek islands most visitors picture: green, wetter, and with a working old town that operates all year round.
why: Corfu Town is a full urban centre, not a resort strip
Year-round activity, not only in summer
A relatively large island with dispersed infrastructure
Close to Albania and the mainland by ferry
corfu.local: Most licensed pharmacies are in Corfu Town and its immediate surroundings. The island is elongated, and villages in the north and south are far — a 40 to 60 minute drive into town is not unusual. If you are staying in Sidari or Kassiopi, factor that in.
corfu.tip: Corfu is wetter than the other islands and its season is shorter. Outside the summer months direct flights thin out and the route goes through Athens.
corfu.season: Corfu is green because it rains. The wet season runs from November to March and it is significant. In summer the island is pleasant and less hot than the Aegean. Direct flights are seasonal; the rest of the year the route goes via Athens. Corfu Town, unlike the resort villages, functions as a full town all year.
corfu.timing: The island is long and getting into town from the north or south takes time. As in Crete, that turns a prescription arranged in advance into a real saving rather than a nicety.
corfu.q1: We're arriving in October. Is it still season?
corfu.a1: The end of it. Some resort villages are already starting to close, but Corfu Town is fully active. If you are travelling in October or later, plan to redeem in town rather than in a village.
corfu.q2: Is the process any different from the other islands?
corfu.a2: No. Same questionnaire, same physician, same digital prescription. The only difference is logistical — how far the pharmacy is from where you are staying.
